Among all segments, service robots stand out as the most sought-after track. 2026-07-06 Learn More Vulnerability Disclosure Policy (VDP) KEENON Robotics has published its Vulnerability Disclosure Policy (VDP) effective June 5, 2026, in compliance with the Australian Cyber Security (Security Standards for Smart Devices) Rules 2025. This policy applies to security vulnerabilities found in our connectable products, including service robots, mobile apps, cloud services, and firmware. We commit to acknowledging reports within 48 hours, providing regular updates, resolving validated vulnerabilities promptly, and ensuring transparency. Researchers are encouraged to report issues via it_service@keenon.com. After reporting, expect acknowledgement within 48 hours, severity assessment, updates every 14 days, and resolution notification with credit optional. We offer safe harbor for good-faith researchers who avoid harm, comply with this policy, and report directly to us first.
